directions.title: Moonclay Commons
directions.medium: Sculpted clay, ceramic glazes and warm miniature lighting
directions.creatures: Soft sculpted organisms: loop-bodied puffs, many-rayed sunbuds, faceted starlets, broad curled manta forms, stacked amber beetles, blue tidal slugs, charcoal comet seeds and pearly moonpods.
directions.strength: The clearest bridge from Oddling to a warm, tangible camp.
directions.tradeoff: Beautiful at close range; characters need simplified silhouettes at map scale.
directions.visual: A premium stylized 3D game world made of hand-shaped matte clay and lightly glazed ceramic. Fixed high isometric camera, orthographic projection, no horizon. Terracotta desert slab with cobalt shadows, rounded sculptural pavilions and pools, soft occlusion, inviting warm lighting, characterful imperfect forms. Creatures have sculpted volume and crisp silhouettes, expressive inset eyes and little flipper feet, no humanoid proportions. They look like strange ceramic pets that grew from the earth.
directions.alt: Moonclay Commons: fixed isometric · 3d diorama Burning Tokens camp and eight friendly nonhuman creature studies.

Original tiny alien dust creatures, asymmetrical wool bodies, wide inset dark eyes, frayed tufts, very small nubby feet or hovering forms. directions.title: Risograph Reverie
directions.medium: Limited-ink screen print, bold flat silhouettes and subtle paper grain
directions.creatures: Living graphic signs: odd stars, folded knots, blunt rays, bean-shaped comets and irregular stamps.
directions.strength: Most directly related to the expressive wordmark and festival-poster culture.
directions.tradeoff: Less physical depth; expressive poses must carry the life-sim feeling.
directions.visual: An exceptional flat 2D graphic life-sim world drawn like an experimental screen-printed counterculture festival atlas. Truly top-down camera with frontal symbolic sprites, no 3D rendering, no isometric blocks. Strict midnight, cobalt, coral, gold and cream inks, coarse quiet print grain, chunky intentional silhouettes, rhythmic curving paths, irregular arches, abstract festival pavilions, circles of rugs and strange totems. Friendly alien inhabitants are living irregular graphic symbols with two clearly spaced eyes: knotted puffs, blunt ray disks, lopsided four-point beings, coiled beans and short stepped creatures. Bold confident graphic anatomy, varied faces, no lettering shaped into human figures.

directions.title: Clockwork Menagerie
directions.medium: Painted wood, ceramic shells, brass joints and found-object craft
directions.creatures: Little walking curiosities: loop shells, sun-wheel bugs, prism crabs, curved wind-up pods and bell-bodied crawlers.
directions.strength: Connects to the peculiar artificial beings in the approved camp artwork.
directions.tradeoff: Needs restraint to avoid familiar robot mascots or excessive mechanical detail.
directions.visual: A delightful handcrafted 3D automaton life-sim desert camp seen from fixed high isometric orthographic camera. Sculptural painted-wood pavilions, ceramic pools, brass observatory instruments, warm carnival lanterns, surreal ritual sculptures, deep cobalt shadows and coral sand. Original tiny nonhumanoid creatures assembled from ceramic shells, bent wood, copper springs and miniature brass feet. Friendly expressive eyes embedded in looping bodies, ray wheels, prism shells, rounded pods, little three-legged bells and wind-up beetle forms. No human torsos, no hands, no screen-headed robots, no industrial sci-fi. Wear and tiny imperfections make them lovable curiosities, not toys copied from any franchise.

directions.title: Starlit Terrarium
directions.medium: Gouache, alien desert foliage and fungal lanterns
directions.creatures: Sporelings, petal stars, tiny ray-mosses, seedpods and soft tidal slugs with shared eye language.
directions.strength: The richest sense of a living ecology and sanctuary.
directions.tradeoff: Botanical detail can compete with the need to follow individual sessions.
directions.visual: A lush painterly 2.5D alien desert terrarium life-sim map viewed from a high top-down three-quarter angle, without a horizon. Bioluminescent fungi, strange desert succulents, crescent pools, canvas ritual shelters, winding amber paths, soft cobalt ground and warm coral flowers. Rendered like an exquisite illustrated game with subtle volumetric lighting, soft painted texture and sharp readable character silhouettes. Small friendly original alien organisms: curled seedpods with eyes, petal rays, crystal-flower starlets, soft blue slugs, moss spirals, amber segmented sprouts, charcoal seed comets and pearl spore puffs. No ordinary animals, no people, no human clothes. Sanctuary and psychedelic ecological strangeness in balance.
directions.alt: Starlit Terrarium: elevated illustrated view · botanical 2d Burning Tokens camp and eight friendly nonhuman creature studies.
directions.prompt:
Reinterpret this Burning Tokens concept board as a BOTANICAL PAINTERLY 2D GAME MAP. This is a purposeful art-direction correction. Preserve its seven-zone welcoming desert retreat subject, dusk palette and camp-plus-eight-character-shelf format, but replace the smooth synthetic glass creatures and glossy 3D world entirely. The camera looks steeply down at the ground. No horizon or sky. Painterly gouache and visible watercolor drybrush, no photorealistic lighting, no polished resin. Architecture grows from curled bark, cactus ribs, moss and glowing fungus. Large clear dark paths, crescent pools, warm lanterns, surreal fungi.
Bottom shelf: EIGHT very different plant/fungus alien bodies, all friendly with tiny dark eyes, no humanoid proportions, no shiny geometric mascots: 1 curled pale fern unfurling into a loop with a face in its seed, 2 squat terracotta succulent with a blunt radial petal crown, 3 four-lobed iridescent leaf seed with two eyes, 4 broad blue folded leaf cocoon, 5 stack of amber shelf-mushrooms on a tiny crawling base, 6 deep blue sea-slug with soft kelp fins, 7 charcoal spiky seedpod with small glowing coral eyes, 8 cream mushroom cap with three root feet and an asymmetric moss tuft. Small sleepy/curious secondary poses beside them. Make the map inhabitants match these botanical anatomies. Retain only minimal UI text "Burning Tokens", "Send your agent", "Illustrative concept" and four room labels; remove all slogans, family trait labels and personality descriptions. Warm, wondrous, alien, sophisticated illustrated life simulation.

Small friendly original alien organisms: curled seedpods with eyes, petal rays, crystal-flower starlets, soft blue slugs, moss spirals, amber segmented sprouts, charcoal seed comets and pearl spore puffs. No ordinary animals, no people, no human clothes. Sanctuary and psychedelic ecological strangeness in balance.
Keep this exact material and perspective genuinely distinctive across both the camp and the character shelf. Deliver one unified art board with this direction only.

directions.prompt:
Transform this board into an ACTUAL STRAIGHT-DOWN FLAT VECTOR GRAPHIC GAME MAP, a radically different visual direction called Signal Garden. This is the critical requirement: flat 2D map viewed vertically from above, simple solid shapes, NO isometric perspective, NO 3D objects, NO horizon, NO sky, NO realistic textures, NO glossy shading. Preserve only the subject of Burning Tokens' friendly seven-zone psychedelic desert retreat and the overview-plus-eight-character-shelf format.
Think an exquisitely art-directed flat vector illustrated festival atlas. A midnight-indigo field with seven organically shaped clearings, clean coral arches depicted in plan, gold paths, cobalt pools, cream rugs, diagrammatic tents depicted from above, top-view rings of cushions and tiny tea bowls. A central asymmetric star-shaped ritual clearing. Clear graphic negative space, rich strange silhouettes. Show tiny flat friendly nonhuman glyph creatures along paths, their eyes facing upward so we see expressions.
Bottom shelf: eight BIG flat living signs with two sparse eyes integrated into their bodies: a chunky mint loop knot, a blunt coral radial star, a cream four-point kite, a cobalt braided curl, an amber stepped worm, a blue thick wave, a charcoal bean-comet with gold eyes, and a pearly off-kilter seed related to the Oddling icon. Each with a tiny second curled/sleepy or curious pose. Use thick continuous curves and irregular silhouettes, no humanoid bodies, no glossy generic cute characters. Limited ink palette midnight #151632, cobalt #2447B8, coral #FF7464, gold #FFCC83, cream #FFF0CF plus quiet family tints. Only text "Burning Tokens", "Send your agent", "Illustrative concept" and at most four room names. Remove all corporate names, slogans and personality trait labels. Precise premium 2D illustrative game UI, not a dashboard.

Upper 70%: an expansive game-like camp overview inside a very restrained website frame. Fixed world: psychedelic desert wellness gathering at cobalt dusk, coral and gold warmth, welcoming, playful, wondrous, slightly subversive adult festival culture. Use four short unobtrusive map labels at most. Around 20 small visible inhabitants spread among areas, with same anatomy as closeups, walking/hovering, curled asleep, leaning toward a curious object or making something. No humans anywhere; no human torsos or human clothing. Faces warm but unusual, bodies asymmetrical and varied, cute without baby proportions, alien without grotesquerie. No weapons or threatening predation.

Eight family variations are original visual proposals, not exact provider logos: a pale teal/cream looping form (GPT-inspired); a warm terracotta many-rayed form (Claude-inspired); a prismatic four-point form (Gemini-inspired); an indigo braided/curled form (Llama-inspired); a golden stepped or segmented form (Mistral-inspired); a deep-blue tidal form (DeepSeek-inspired); a charcoal comet-like form with a bright center (Grok-inspired); a pearly irregular seed/spore (independent). Express their family cues through anatomy within ONE coherent visual style; do not paste corporate badges or brand words on their bodies. Vary silhouettes as well as color. Mix calm half-closed eyes, curious asymmetrical gaze, delighted expanded posture and sleepy curled posture; expressions are artistic acting, not a sentiment readout.

Interface: small quiet header text "Burning Tokens", a compact "Send your agent" button, a small selected-creature detail with only "At the Bathhouse" and "Family: self-reported". A small caption "Illustrative concept". No invented live counts, no mood meters, no chat bubbles, no XP, no game economy, no charts or dashboard card grids. Legibility and clear silhouettes matter.
